title: Source usage log
intro: What was taken from each source and where it shows up in the app. 'used' items fed real content (linked below), 'skipped' items were off-topic, and 'failed' items could not be loaded and should be re-checked. Use this to trace any recommendation back to its origin.

More May-2026 patch notes (Slingers, Champs, Xolotl techs).
Tournament results, lan reactions, video-production notes — no strategy.

Detailed May-2026 patch numbers: Slingers 70f10w→50f25w (+2s convert-resist); Champi Feudal 120f60g→90f60g, Castle-up 200f175g→150f175g, faster training; Xolotl gains all American crown-techs (Aztec +4 atk, Mayan +40hp, Incan +1/+1, etc.).
Continuous unique-unit production from a Castle or Monastery costs ~168 food/min (~8 unbowed farms); Monastery-UU + rams can out-push Castle-UU.
One-trick civ/build abusers rarely beat prepared opponents — only near-perfect execution (e.g. Hoang) sustains it.
Goths, an infantry civ, carry a near-complete navy — full ship line plus Careening and Shipwright, missing only Dry Dock (verified vs. the tech tree).

Parsed down to ~#1169 (batch-2 density ~1/10 — one durable fact extracted to Tips; rest was Redbull map reveals, Xbox-leadership news, showmatch/LAN chatter). Pagination continues further back; this pointer advances per batch.
